text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — dashboard shows p95 jump on /v1/generate at 2026-03-15 11:12 UTC but sample_count for that route dropped by ~40%. looks like some requests got routed to the new 'router-v2' and lost the sample_origin tag on ingress.
Maya Singh: can you paste the raw event for one of those requests? curious whether the label was stripped at the router or earlier.
Alex Chen: here's an anonymized event from raw-telemetry: 
```
{"route":"/v1/generate","model":"gpt-4r","lat_ms":342,"sample_count":1,"labels":{}}
```
note labels is empty where we expect sample_origin.
Samir Patel: hmm. router-v2 intentionally rewrites some labels to reduce cardinality. we added a label whitelist but looks like sample_origin wasn't whitelisted. I assumed telemetry would add it later in the ingestion pipeline.
Priya Gomez: dropping sample_origin will break breakdowns by edge/router/cache and make endpoint p95 mixes look noisy. that's basically what Alex saw. storing origin per-sample is important for debugging tail latency regressions.
Maya Singh: agree we need the origin in the dashboard for per-endpoint breakdowns. but we should be mindful of cardinality cost — we have potentially many router ids and origins. proposal: expose a small enumish label: edge|router|cache|fallback instead of full router id.
Samir Patel: that seems reasonable. current whitelist allows edge/router/cache, but router-v2 used an internal key 'sr' and then removes it. two problems: (1) inconsistent key names between router versions, (2) ingestion expects 'sample_origin' exact key.
Alex Chen: suggested quick fix: patch router-v2 to forward sample_origin as 'sample_origin' and stop stripping it. that would restore the dashboard immediately.
Samir Patel: I can ship a revert/patch but want a longer-term contract between routing and telemetry. propose an internal API: router will set labels.sample_origin with one of [edge, router, cache, fallback] and telemetry ingestion will treat that key as low-cardinality allowed label. also telemetry will normalize alias keys (e.g., sr -> sample_origin) for a transitional window.
Maya Singh: sounds good. what about the UI? Console latency widgets currently roll up by endpoint only. We should surface a small toggle: "breakdown by origin" so users can split p50/p95 by sample_origin. toggle off by default to avoid extra fetches.
Priya Gomez: also add a note in rollout UX: when a route moves traffic between routers, dashboards should show origin-trend annotations. people often mistake p95 jumps as model regressions when it's router handoff.
Alex Chen: agreed. putting it in the rollout annotations would have saved us debugging time.
Samir Patel: implementation plan: (1) patch router-v2 to forward sample_origin key within next deploy (tracked in PR #4823) (2) ingest normalization for legacy keys in telemetry (3) add enum whitelist and telemetry schema change docs (4) Console: add "by origin" toggle + small legend. timeline: 2 days for patch, 1 week for ingestion + UI spike.
Maya Singh: can we do a temporary dashboard annotation to help current customers? e.g., add an overlay note when route-version changes detected for an endpoint in the last 24h.
Priya Gomez: yes, create an event stream from rollout service -> console so UI can show "traffic shifted to router-v2 at T". low-effort: emit a one-off marker in timeline.
Samir Patel: I'll open the PRs. Alex can you add a minimal reproducer and a log snippet in the issue? also tagging @deploy-bot to warn if we roll router again soon.
Alex Chen: added minimal repro logs to the issue and link: https://git.internal/r/4823
deploy-bot: deploy notification: router-v2 rolled to us-west on 2026-03-14T22:45Z by samir.patel — revision 7f3b1a9
Maya Singh: thanks. Samir, please include the ingestion whitelist change in telemetry CHANGELOG and add a one-week migration window for key normalization.
Samir Patel: will do. thinking about storage impact — since sample_origin is low-cardinality enum it should be fine. we'll add a nightly job to count distinct sample_origin per endpoint to monitor.
Priya Gomez: one last ask: add a quick Console UX note to customer-facing release notes about "Dashboard origin breakdown" once shipped. helps support.
Alex Chen: great. summary: patch router to forward sample_origin today, ingestion normalization + schema change next week, UI toggle + rollout annotations in the following sprint. if anyone sees more events missing labels, drop them here and cc @Samir. :thumbsup:
